title: TCC — três vasos, ensaio contínuo
description: 30 dias contínuos. n=1 por tratamento. Quinzenas são períodos, não réplicas. Simulação não é resultado físico.

list.name: experiment
list.label: Experimento
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT experiment_id AS __text, experiment_id AS __value FROM telemetry WHERE source = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1

list.name: inicio
list.label: Início do ensaio físico (ISO, São Paulo)

list.name: fim
list.label: Fim do ensaio físico (ISO, São Paulo)

options.content: Origem **$source**, experimento **$experiment**. Três vasos, **n=1 por tratamento**; resultados descritivos. Fonte física: janela **$inicio → $fim** (ajuste nas variáveis ao iniciar o ensaio; duração real pode ser menor que 30 dias por decisão de 04/11). Metades são períodos de análise, não réplicas. A seção "ao vivo" mostra leituras brutas da bancada antes da calibração; simulação não comprova economia.

panels.title: Última mensagem recebida (segundos atrás)
panels.description: Telemetria a cada 60 s. Acima de 180 s: verificar Wi-Fi, IP do notebook ou alimentação do ESP32.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()-max(received_at)) AS segundos FROM telemetry WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring}

panels.title: Solo — leitura bruta do ADC por vaso (sem calibração; maior = mais seco)

targets.rawSql: SELECT collected_at AS time, unit_id AS metric, (payload->>'soil_raw')::int AS value FROM telemetry WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Balança compartilhada — massa (g, calibração provisória; deriva não corrigida)

targets.rawSql: SELECT collected_at AS time, (payload->>'reservoir_mass_g')::float AS massa_g FROM telemetry WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring} AND unit_id=(SELECT min(unit_id) FROM telemetry WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY 1

SELECT collected_at AS time, (payload->>'temperature_c')::float AS temperatura_c, (payload->>'humidity_pct')::float AS umidade_pct FROM telemetry WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring} AND unit_id=(SELECT min(unit_id) FROM telemetry WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY 1

WITH sim AS (SELECT min(collected_at) AS first_at FROM telemetry WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring}), anchor AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ${source:sqlstring}='physical' THEN ${inicio:sqlstring}::timestamptz ELSE first_at END AS start_at, CASE WHEN ${source:sqlstring}='physical' THEN ${fim:sqlstring}::timestamptz ELSE first_at+interval '30 days' END AS stop_at FROM sim), bounds AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ${period:sqlstring}='segunda_metade' THEN start_at+(stop_at-start_at)/2 ELSE start_at END AS begin_at, CASE WHEN ${period:sqlstring}='primeira_metade' THEN start_at+(stop_at-start_at)/2 ELSE stop_at END AS end_at FROM anchor) SELECT collected_at AS time, soil_index AS value, unit_id || ' / ' || treatment AS metric FROM telemetry CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE source = ${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id = ${experiment:sqlstring} AND sensor_valid AND collected_at>=begin_at AND collected_at<end_at AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at

WITH sim AS (SELECT min(collected_at) AS first_at FROM telemetry WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring}), anchor AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ${source:sqlstring}='physical' THEN ${inicio:sqlstring}::timestamptz ELSE first_at END AS start_at, CASE WHEN ${source:sqlstring}='physical' THEN ${fim:sqlstring}::timestamptz ELSE first_at+interval '30 days' END AS stop_at FROM sim), bounds AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ${period:sqlstring}='segunda_metade' THEN start_at+(stop_at-start_at)/2 ELSE start_at END AS begin_at, CASE WHEN ${period:sqlstring}='primeira_metade' THEN start_at+(stop_at-start_at)/2 ELSE stop_at END AS end_at FROM anchor) SELECT count(*) AS messages FROM telemetry CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE source = ${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id = ${experiment:sqlstring} AND collected_at>=begin_at AND collected_at<end_at AND $__timeFilter(collected_at)

WITH sim AS (SELECT min(collected_at) AS first_at FROM telemetry WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring}), anchor AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ${source:sqlstring}='physical' THEN ${inicio:sqlstring}::timestamptz ELSE first_at END AS start_at, CASE WHEN ${source:sqlstring}='physical' THEN ${fim:sqlstring}::timestamptz ELSE first_at+interval '30 days' END AS stop_at FROM sim), bounds AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ${period:sqlstring}='segunda_metade' THEN start_at+(stop_at-start_at)/2 ELSE start_at END AS begin_at, CASE WHEN ${period:sqlstring}='primeira_metade' THEN start_at+(stop_at-start_at)/2 ELSE stop_at END AS end_at FROM anchor) SELECT c.issued_at, c.payload->>'unit_id' AS vaso, c.payload->>'treatment' AS tratamento, c.status, c.payload->>'reason' AS motivo, c.command_id FROM commands c CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE c.source = ${source:sqlstring} AND c.payload->>'experiment_id' = ${experiment:sqlstring} AND c.issued_at>=begin_at AND c.issued_at<end_at AND $__timeFilter(c.issued_at) ORDER BY c.issued_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Água retirada e energia por ciclo confirmado

targets.rawSql: WITH sim AS (SELECT min(collected_at) AS first_at FROM telemetry WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring}), anchor AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ${source:sqlstring}='physical' THEN ${inicio:sqlstring}::timestamptz ELSE first_at END AS start_at, CASE WHEN ${source:sqlstring}='physical' THEN ${fim:sqlstring}::timestamptz ELSE first_at+interval '30 days' END AS stop_at FROM sim), bounds AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ${period:sqlstring}='segunda_metade' THEN start_at+(stop_at-start_at)/2 ELSE start_at END AS begin_at, CASE WHEN ${period:sqlstring}='primeira_metade' THEN start_at+(stop_at-start_at)/2 ELSE stop_at END AS end_at FROM anchor) SELECT e.occurred_at, c.payload->>'unit_id' AS vaso, c.payload->>'treatment' AS tratamento, e.payload->>'volume_ml' AS agua_ml, e.payload->>'energy_wh' AS energia_wh, e.payload->>'measurements_valid' AS medicao_valida, e.payload->>'reason' AS motivo FROM command_events e JOIN commands c USING(command_id) CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE c.source = ${source:sqlstring} AND c.payload->>'experiment_id' = ${experiment:sqlstring} AND e.status IN ('completed','failed') AND e.occurred_at>=begin_at AND e.occurred_at<end_at AND $__timeFilter(e.occurred_at) ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100

WITH sim AS (SELECT min(collected_at) AS first_at FROM telemetry WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring}), anchor AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ${source:sqlstring}='physical' THEN ${inicio:sqlstring}::timestamptz ELSE first_at END AS start_at, CASE WHEN ${source:sqlstring}='physical' THEN ${fim:sqlstring}::timestamptz ELSE first_at+interval '30 days' END AS stop_at FROM sim), bounds AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ${period:sqlstring}='segunda_metade' THEN start_at+(stop_at-start_at)/2 ELSE start_at END AS begin_at, CASE WHEN ${period:sqlstring}='primeira_metade' THEN start_at+(stop_at-start_at)/2 ELSE stop_at END AS end_at FROM anchor) SELECT d.created_at, d.payload->>'reason' AS motivo, d.payload->>'actuate' AS irrigar, d.payload->>'prediction_id' AS previsao, d.payload->>'command_id' AS comando FROM decisions d JOIN telemetry t ON t.device_id=d.device_id AND t.message_id=(d.payload->>'telemetry_message_id')::uuid CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE t.source = ${source:sqlstring} AND t.experiment_id = ${experiment:sqlstring} AND d.created_at>=begin_at AND d.created_at<end_at AND $__timeFilter(d.created_at) ORDER BY d.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Consumo observado válido por vaso — sem preencher ausências

targets.rawSql: WITH sim AS (SELECT min(collected_at) AS first_at FROM telemetry WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring}), anchor AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ${source:sqlstring}='physical' THEN ${inicio:sqlstring}::timestamptz ELSE first_at END AS start_at, CASE WHEN ${source:sqlstring}='physical' THEN ${fim:sqlstring}::timestamptz ELSE first_at+interval '30 days' END AS stop_at FROM sim), bounds AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ${period:sqlstring}='segunda_metade' THEN start_at+(stop_at-start_at)/2 ELSE start_at END AS begin_at, CASE WHEN ${period:sqlstring}='primeira_metade' THEN start_at+(stop_at-start_at)/2 ELSE stop_at END AS end_at FROM anchor), cycles AS (SELECT e.command_id,e.occurred_at,c.payload->>'unit_id' AS unit_id,c.payload->>'treatment' AS treatment,e.payload FROM command_events e JOIN commands c USING(command_id) WHERE c.source=${source:sqlstring} AND c.payload->>'experiment_id'=${experiment:sqlstring} AND e.status IN ('completed','failed') UNION ALL SELECT command_id,occurred_at,payload->>'unit_id',payload->>'treatment',payload FROM local_cycle_events WHERE payload->>'source'=${source:sqlstring} AND payload->>'experiment_id'=${experiment:sqlstring} AND status IN ('completed','failed')) SELECT unit_id AS vaso,treatment AS tratamento,count(*) AS ciclos_com_resultado,count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT coalesce((payload->>'measurements_valid')::boolean,false) OR payload->>'volume_ml' IS NULL OR payload->>'energy_wh' IS NULL) AS ciclos_sem_medicao,sum((payload->>'volume_ml')::float) FILTER(WHERE (payload->>'measurements_valid')::boolean) AS agua_valida_observada_ml,sum((payload->>'energy_wh')::float) FILTER(WHERE (payload->>'measurements_valid')::boolean) AS energia_valida_observada_wh FROM cycles,bounds WHERE occurred_at>=begin_at AND occurred_at<end_at AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY unit_id,treatment ORDER BY treatment

panels.title: Leituras e cobertura por vaso — períodos não são réplicas

targets.rawSql: WITH sim AS (SELECT min(collected_at) AS first_at FROM telemetry WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring}), anchor AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ${source:sqlstring}='physical' THEN ${inicio:sqlstring}::timestamptz ELSE first_at END AS start_at, CASE WHEN ${source:sqlstring}='physical' THEN ${fim:sqlstring}::timestamptz ELSE first_at+interval '30 days' END AS stop_at FROM sim), bounds AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ${period:sqlstring}='segunda_metade' THEN start_at+(stop_at-start_at)/2 ELSE start_at END AS begin_at, CASE WHEN ${period:sqlstring}='primeira_metade' THEN start_at+(stop_at-start_at)/2 ELSE stop_at END AS end_at FROM anchor) SELECT t.unit_id AS vaso,t.treatment AS tratamento,count(*) AS leituras,count(*) FILTER(WHERE sensor_valid) AS leituras_validas,count(DISTINCT floor(extract(epoch FROM(t.collected_at-b.begin_at))/60)) FILTER(WHERE sensor_valid) AS minutos_com_leitura_valida,100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE sensor_valid)/nullif(count(*),0) AS percentual_validas_observadas FROM telemetry t CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring} AND collected_at>=begin_at AND collected_at<end_at AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) GROUP BY t.unit_id,t.treatment ORDER BY t.treatment

SELECT occurred_at,payload->>'unit_id' AS vaso,payload->>'treatment' AS tratamento,status,payload->>'reason' AS motivo,command_id FROM local_cycle_events WHERE payload->>'source'=${source:sqlstring} AND payload->>'experiment_id'=${experiment:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT started_at,ended_at,unit_id AS vaso,kind AS tipo,status,payload->>'reason' AS motivo,payload->>'responsible' AS responsavel FROM interventions WHERE payload->>'source'=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Comandos sem resultado terminal — verificar antes de concluir consumo

targets.rawSql: SELECT issued_at,payload->>'unit_id' AS vaso,payload->>'treatment' AS tratamento,status,command_id FROM commands WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND payload->>'experiment_id'=${experiment:sqlstring} AND status IN('queued','published','accepted','started','expired') AND $__timeFilter(issued_at) ORDER BY issued_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Rejeições e falhas de transporte — por dispositivo

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at,topic,reason FROM rejected_messages WHERE split_part(topic,'/',3) IN(SELECT DISTINCT device_id FROM telemetry WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: T3: erro da previsão de 30 min — pares válidos e alvos ausentes

targets.rawSql: WITH sim AS (SELECT min(collected_at) AS first_at FROM telemetry WHERE source=${source:sqlstring} AND experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring}), anchor AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ${source:sqlstring}='physical' THEN ${inicio:sqlstring}::timestamptz ELSE first_at END AS start_at, CASE WHEN ${source:sqlstring}='physical' THEN ${fim:sqlstring}::timestamptz ELSE first_at+interval '30 days' END AS stop_at FROM sim), bounds AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ${period:sqlstring}='segunda_metade' THEN start_at+(stop_at-start_at)/2 ELSE start_at END AS begin_at, CASE WHEN ${period:sqlstring}='primeira_metade' THEN start_at+(stop_at-start_at)/2 ELSE stop_at END AS end_at FROM anchor) SELECT base.unit_id AS vaso,p.payload->>'model_version' AS modelo,count(*) AS previsoes,count(obs.soil_index) AS pares_validos,count(*)-count(obs.soil_index) AS alvos_ausentes,avg(abs((p.payload->>'soil_index')::float-obs.soil_index)) AS mae,sqrt(avg(power((p.payload->>'soil_index')::float-obs.soil_index,2))) AS rmse,avg(abs(base.soil_index-obs.soil_index)) AS mae_persistencia FROM predictions p JOIN telemetry base ON base.device_id=p.device_id AND base.message_id=(p.payload->>'telemetry_message_id')::uuid CROSS JOIN bounds LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT t.soil_index FROM telemetry t WHERE t.device_id=base.device_id AND t.unit_id=base.unit_id AND t.experiment_id=base.experiment_id AND t.source=base.source AND t.payload->>'calibration_id'=base.payload->>'calibration_id' AND t.sensor_valid AND t.collected_at>=base.collected_at+interval '30 minutes' AND t.collected_at<=base.collected_at+interval '31 minutes' AND t.collected_at<bounds.end_at ORDER BY t.collected_at LIMIT 1) obs ON true WHERE base.source=${source:sqlstring} AND base.experiment_id=${experiment:sqlstring} AND base.treatment='T3' AND base.collected_at>=begin_at AND base.collected_at<end_at AND $__timeFilter(base.collected_at) GROUP BY base.unit_id,p.payload->>'model_version' ORDER BY base.unit_id
